author: (Dall, 1903)

note.en: A small cardita with strong ribs that attaches under rocks in shallow water. Two museum specimens come from 4 m off Punta Uva. Size is approximate (no measured value found).
note.es: Una cardita pequeña de costillas fuertes que se fija bajo rocas en aguas someras. Dos ejemplares de museo vienen de 4 m frente a Punta Uva. El tamaño es aproximado (no se encontró una medida publicada).

evidence: GBIF: 2 preserved specimen(s) in the region (INBio Atta collection, 1998) off Punta Uva

sources.t: GBIF occurrence records (INBio Atta specimen collection and other museum records), Gandoca to Limón
